title: Unreal Gameplay Ability System Toolkit
description: Managing ability state across networked Unreal projects was fragmented and error-prone. Built a modular GAS layer that wraps attribute sets, effect handles, and prediction keys behind a single surface. Reduced cross-team integration time on ability features from days to hours.

title: Cross-Engine Asset Pipeline Bridge
description: Art teams switching between Unreal and Unity lost hours per sprint manually re-exporting and re-importing assets. Wrote a CLI tool that reads FBX metadata and emits engine-specific import configs for both targets. Cut asset turnaround from 45 minutes to under 3 minutes per batch.

title: Build Pipeline Monitor
description: CI build failures in large Unreal projects produced thousands of log lines with no actionable signal. Built a Docker-based log aggregator that parses Unreal build output, deduplicates errors by file and code, and posts a compact summary to a webhook. Mean time to identify a broken build dropped from 12 minutes to under 90 seconds.
